focus_areas: Cup-saucer contact physics and depth separation
Consistency of specular highlights on curved surfaces
Sharpness of the rim vs. background blur
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the handle attachment points. In AI images, handles often appear fused or slightly detached. Verify if the shadow cast by the handle onto the cup body is consistent with the lighting direction. Also, check if the elliptical perspective of the cup rim matches the elliptical perspective of the saucer below it. Ensure the saucer is treated as a distinct physical object with its own depth and boundary, not just a flat texture under the cup.
image_description: A black and white close-up photograph of a ceramic teacup resting on a matching saucer. The cup has a rounded body and a C-shaped handle on the right side. It sits on a surface that appears to be paper with faint text or patterns, possibly a newspaper or book page. The lighting is soft, creating gentle shadows and highlights on the glossy ceramic surface.
